summary: 21Shares Ethereum Staking ETF filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting that sponsor 21Shares US LLC extended its voluntary 100% sponsor fee waiver through October 8, 2027, an additional twelve months beyond the prior October 2025 arrangement. No securities, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is involved; the waiver applies automatically to all current and prospective shareholders with no investor action. Net staking reward for TETH stood at 2.65% as of October 1, 2026. This is a routine fee-waiver extension for an exchange-traded fund, not a transactional special situation.
